title: melicope knudsenii
intro: Melicope knudsenii, commonly known as Knudsen's melicope, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family. It is native to Hawaii and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Melicope knudsenii include flavonoids, limonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits, including anti-cancer and anti-microbial properties.
